population: 28 frozen main suites; five paired systems; one typed decision per row
intervals: pointwise descriptive 95% percentile cluster bootstrap by source/state group within suite; 5000 draws; no cross-suite inference

definitions.best_single: maximum observed accuracy among the five systems on this suite; same-data selected, descriptive
definitions.oracle: fraction with at least one of five correct outputs; reference-aware selector upper bound, not a deployable router
definitions.oracle_headroom: oracle minus best_single; recompute the maximum within each bootstrap draw
definitions.majority_coverage: fraction with at least three identical valid labels among the fixed five systems
definitions.majority_risk: error fraction among strict-majority-covered decisions; undefined when no majority
definitions.majority_yield: correct strict-majority decisions divided by all decisions; unanswered decisions do not contribute
definitions.majority_yield_minus_best: majority_yield minus same-sample best single-system accuracy; different coverage and not a matched selective-risk comparison
definitions.unanimous_wrong: fraction where all five return the identical wrong valid label
